concepts.title: 单位圆与对称性
concepts.summary: 单位圆为$x^2+y^2=1$，半径1，周长$2\pi$。关于$x$轴、$y$轴、原点、$y=x$的对称点分别为$(x,-y)$、$(-x,y)$、$(-x,-y)$、$(y,x)$。

method.title: 方法

en.title: The unit circle and symmetry
en.summary: The unit circle is $x^2+y^2=1$, with radius 1 and circumference $2\pi$. Reflections in the $x$-axis, $y$-axis, origin, and $y=x$ give $(x,-y)$, $(-x,y)$, $(-x,-y)$, and $(y,x)$.

method.title: Method
method.body: The unit circle is $x^2+y^2=1$, with radius 1 and circumference $2\pi$. Reflections in the $x$-axis, $y$-axis, origin, and $y=x$ give $(x,-y)$, $(-x,y)$, $(-x,-y)$, and $(y,x)$.

concepts.title: 终点与六个三角函数
concepts.summary: 实数$t$从$(1,0)$起沿单位圆缠绕到$P(t)=(x,y)$。$\sin t=y$，$\cos t=x$，$\tan t=y/x$，$\csc t=1/y$，$\sec t=1/x$，$\cot t=x/y$。分母为零时函数无定义。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 实数$t$从$(1,0)$起沿单位圆缠绕到$P(t)=(x,y)$。$\sin t=y$，$\cos t=x$，$\tan t=y/x$，$\csc t=1/y$，$\sec t=1/x$，$\cot t=x/y$。分母为零时函数无定义。

en.title: Terminal points and the six functions
en.summary: Wrap real number $t$ around the unit circle from $(1,0)$ to $P(t)=(x,y)$. Then $\sin t=y$, $\cos t=x$, $\tan t=y/x$, $\csc t=1/y$, $\sec t=1/x$, and $\cot t=x/y$. A zero denominator makes the function undefined.

method.title: Method
method.body: Wrap real number $t$ around the unit circle from $(1,0)$ to $P(t)=(x,y)$. Then $\sin t=y$, $\cos t=x$, $\tan t=y/x$, $\csc t=1/y$, $\sec t=1/x$, and $\cot t=x/y$. A zero denominator makes the function undefined.

en.title: Quadrantal angles
en.summary: Angles $0,\pi/2,\pi,3\pi/2$ have terminal points $(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)$. Compute functions from coordinates, checking denominators first.

method.title: Method
method.body: Angles $0,\pi/2,\pi,3\pi/2$ have terminal points $(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)$. Compute functions from coordinates, checking denominators first.

concepts.title: 常用角及象限符号
concepts.summary: $\pi/6,\pi/4,\pi/3$对应$(\sqrt3/2,1/2),(\sqrt2/2,\sqrt2/2),(1/2,\sqrt3/2)$。利用对称性改变坐标符号，先确定象限再求函数值。

en.title: Common angles and quadrant signs
en.summary: Angles $\pi/6,\pi/4,\pi/3$ have points $(\sqrt3/2,1/2),(\sqrt2/2,\sqrt2/2),(1/2,\sqrt3/2)$. Use symmetry to determine signs in other quadrants before evaluating functions.

concepts.title: 完整周与所有对应实数
concepts.summary: $P(t+2n\pi)=P(t)$，$n\in\mathbb Z$。先将角化到$[0,2\pi)$；要求全部实数时，在基本角后加$2n\pi$。

method.title: 方法

en.title: Complete turns and all corresponding real numbers
en.summary: $P(t+2n\pi)=P(t)$, $n\in\mathbb Z$. Reduce angles to $[0,2\pi)$; to list all corresponding real numbers, add $2n\pi$ to a representative angle.

method.title: Method

steps.title: Use the unit-circle and sign conditions

exercises.prompt: 设$P(t)=(x,y)$为单位圆终点。若$xy=0$且$x<0$，求$\cos t,\sin t$。

en.prompt: Let $P(t)=(x,y)$ be a terminal point on the unit circle. If $xy=0$ and $x<0$, find $\cos t,\sin t$.

steps.title: Use the unit-circle and sign conditions
steps.body: Because $x<0$, $x\ne0$; hence $xy=0$ implies $y=0$. Then $x^2+0=1$ and $x<0$ give $x=-1$.

exercises.prompt: 求$[3000\pi,3010\pi]$中使$\tan t$无定义的全部$t$。

steps.title: 无定义条件
steps.body: $\tan t=\sin t/\cos t$，故$\cos t=0$时无定义，即$t=\pi/2+k\pi$。

en.prompt: Find all $t$ in $[3000\pi,3010\pi]$ for which $\tan t$ is undefined.

steps.title: Undefined condition
steps.body: $\tan t=\sin t/\cos t$, so it is undefined when $\cos t=0$, or $t=\pi/2+k\pi$.

exercises.prompt: $[0,2000\pi]$中有多少个数使$\sec t$无定义？

en.prompt: For how many numbers in $[0,2000\pi]$ is $\sec t$ undefined?

steps.title: Undefined condition
steps.body: $\sec t=1/\cos t$, so it is undefined at $t=\pi/2+k\pi$, $k\in\mathbb Z$.

steps.title: Count the integers
steps.body: $0\le\pi/2+k\pi\le2000\pi$ is equivalent to $-0.5\le k\le1999.5$. Thus $k=0,1,\ldots,1999$, giving 2000 numbers.

exercises.prompt: 点$(x,y),(-x,y),(x,-y),(-x,-y)$分别是单位圆弧长$s,t,u,v$的终点。$\cos(\pi-u),\sin(\pi-u)$与$\cos v,\sin v$有什么关系？

steps.title: 反射终点
steps.body: $P(u)=(x,-y)$，$P(\pi-u)$是其关于$y$轴的对称点$(-x,-y)$，这也正是$P(v)$。

steps.title: 比较坐标
steps.body: 同一终点具有相同横、纵坐标，所以$\cos(\pi-u)=\cos v$，$\sin(\pi-u)=\sin v$。

en.prompt: The points $(x,y),(-x,y),(x,-y),(-x,-y)$ are terminal points on the unit circle of arcs of lengths $s,t,u,v$, respectively. How are $\cos(\pi-u),\sin(\pi-u)$ related to $\cos v,\sin v$?

steps.title: Compare coordinates
steps.body: The same terminal point has the same coordinates, so $\cos(\pi-u)=\cos v$ and $\sin(\pi-u)=\sin v$.

steps.title: 函数的单值性
steps.body: 相同输入经同一函数必得相同输出。因此命题正确。

en.prompt: True or False: If $u=v$, then $\sin u=\sin v$.

steps.title: Use the function property
steps.body: Equal inputs to the same function give equal outputs. Therefore the statement is true.

en.prompt: True or False: If $\cos u=\cos v$, then $u=v$.

steps.title: Give a counterexample
steps.body: Take $u=0,v=2\pi$. Then $\cos0=1=\cos2\pi$ but $0\ne2\pi$, so the statement is false.
